strings.name: Michael Schumacher
strings.summary: Schumacher progressed from karting to professional racing, competing for Benetton, Ferrari and Mercedes and winning seven F1 drivers’ titles. His championship streak with Ferrari influenced training and technical teamwork in modern racing; his aggressive driving also drew penalties. He retired again in 2012, suffered serious injuries skiing the following year, and his family has since kept his health private.
